excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content:
So, what happened in Prysm during the Grandine issue:

When receiving a data column message, spec verifications are executed.
1. There is one called [SidecarInclusionProven](https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/blob/96f4b7d8cb178a1457311fe24b7d38f5782cbb72/beacon-chain/verification/data_column.go#L243-L252).
2. This function calls [VerifyKZGInclusionProofColumn](https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/blob/96f4b7d8cb178a1457311fe24b7d38f5782cbb72/consensus-types/blocks/kzg.go#L50-L77) with the data column sidecar.
3. This function calls [leavesFromCommitments](https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/blob/96f4b7d8cb178a1457311fe24b7d38f5782cbb72/consensus-types/blocks/kzg.go#L141-L150) with the commitments of the data column sidecar.
The output of `3.`  (the leaves) what an empty array (or more precisely an empty slice in go jargon).

The fact that the leaves were empty caused `GeneratTrieFromItems` to return on error, bubbling up to a gossip message rejection.
